description: A probable Roman villa, first excavated in 1749 and well known for its mosaics. It has long been suggested that it may be a religious sanctuary rather than a domestic villa, and Perring has interpreted the famous mosaics as expressing late antique Gnostic beliefs. Dating is uncertain, the mosaics have been argued to have been lain around the mid 4th CE, but the origin of the building is uncertain, it may originate from the same time period. When the structure fell out of use is also uncertain.
